scope: Aligned LasHeR Protocol 2 test split; single IR image modality, complete aligned shared GT
network_input: Only IR frames, converted by the existing ODTrack RGB reader to 3 channels
GT: Complete aligned LasHeR init.txt xywh for initialization and scoring; no per-modality txt fallback, modality maximum or RGB image inputs
sampling: All frames, no VTUAV stride10 sampling

metric_reference.reference_type: Public MATLAB toolkit source audit; single-IR GT adapter
notes: calc_seq_err_robust: repair nonpositive-size/NaN predictions from previous raw result before first-frame GT override
xywh inclusive rectangle IoU and center x+(w-1)/2,y+(h-1)/2
all four GT coordinates >0, otherwise overlap/center/normalized errors -1; all annotation rows in denominator
eval_tracker: strict IoU > 0:0.05:1, center <=0:50, normalized center <=0:0.01:0.5
plot_draw_save: nonzero sequence curves are averaged equally; AUC is arithmetic mean of threshold rates
Explicit NP-AUC and NP@0.20 are both exported; they are not synonyms or silently interchanged
The primary LasHeR dataset/toolkit link is the official repository; the public MATLAB copy above is documented separately
